_comment: Mindfulness nudge library. Each line interrupts a specific mental loop. source '✎' marks an original aphorism; otherwise a named voice from the contemplative tradition. theme is the hidden tag the 'caught' control biases toward.

lines.text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
It is not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
Men are disturbed not by things, but by the opinions they hold about things.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
He who is everywhere is nowhere.
When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
The present moment is filled with joy and happiness. If you are attentive, you will see it.
Be here now.
The quieter you become, the more you are able to hear.
You are the sky. Everything else is just the weather.
Nothing ever goes away until it has taught us what we need to know.
Worry pretends to be necessary but serves no useful purpose.
Realize deeply that the present moment is all you ever have.
Until you make the unconscious conscious, it will direct your life and you will call it fate.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
A journey of a thousand miles begins beneath one's feet.
Muddy water, let stand, becomes clear.
Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
Nothing is so fatiguing as the eternal hanging on of an uncompleted task.
The task you are avoiding is smaller than the dread you built around it. Touch it for sixty seconds.
'Undisciplined' is a verdict. 'Not started yet' is a fact. Only the fact can be changed in the next hour.
You are not the voice that calls you lazy. You are the one who hears it and stands up anyway.
Starting badly still counts as starting. Momentum never checks your form.
You are rehearsing a future that never asked for your permission. Come back to the hour you actually hold.
Replaying it does not edit it. Set it down and pick up the next thing.
You do not have to carry the whole day. Only the next thirty minutes.
The urge to check, scroll, switch: watch it rise and fall without obeying it. It always passes.
Hold what is yours, the next action. Release what is not, the timing and the outcome.
Their chapter twenty is not your chapter three. Stop measuring your inside against their outside.
The plan working matters more than you feeling ready. You will rarely feel ready.
Name three things you can see right now. That is the whole practice. You are back.
Discipline is not a feeling you wait for. It is the bridge you build by walking across it.
Most of the weight you feel is tomorrow's, borrowed early. Hand it back.
Someone is always further ahead. That has never once been a reason to stop walking.
Restlessness is energy with no direction. Aim it at one task and it becomes fuel.
When everything feels urgent, nothing is. Choose the one that scares you and begin there.
You cannot think your way calm. You can act your way there. One small, true action.
